grades.lower_bound_mechanism: RMS–AM–GM chain applied to x and y+c (with f(x)+y = x+f(y))
grades.upper_bound_mechanism: asymptotic alignment of arithmetic forward orbits (all positive displacements equal) + connectedness/openness to exclude coexistence of d=0 and d=c
grades.notes: Complete and rigorous. Section 1 derives f(f(y))=2f(y)-y and d≥0. Section 2 proves all positive displacements equal via Φ(x,v)→0 along aligned orbits. Section 3 uses continuity of Φ and connectedness to rule out mixed fixed/non-fixed points, covering c=0. Section 4 verifies sufficiency for all c≥0.
